account.title: factorio.com account
account.intro: Foreman uses this account to download mods from the Factorio mod portal. Searching for mods works without it.
account.env.text: The account comes from the environment variables {username} and {token}, so it cannot be changed here. To enter an account on this page instead, remove both variables and restart Foreman.
account.nokey: Foreman cannot store an account without a secret key. Set {key} and restart Foreman, or set {username} and {token} instead.
account.none: No account is set, so mod downloads are off. Searching for mods still works.
account.unreadable: A stored account could not be read, so mod downloads are off. The secret key may have changed.
account.unreadable.again: Enter the account again to replace it.
account.username.label: factorio.com username
account.token.label: factorio.com token
account.token.hint: Your token is on your factorio.com profile page. It is stored encrypted and is never shown again.
account.retype: The username and token are never shown again. Type both again.
account.error.env: The account comes from the environment, so it cannot be changed here.
account.error.nokey: Foreman cannot store an account because no secret key is set.
account.remove.heading: Remove the account
account.remove.hint: Mod downloads stop until an account is entered again.
